video_title: Micah Nori Postgame Interview | Portland Trail Blazers 103, Memphis Grizzlies 124 | Oct. 29, 2026

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on Portland's poor shooting and high turnover count
quotes.excerpt: we were 6 for 32 on catch and shoots of the 49s and I told the team
quotes.quote: I think that it kind of started in the first half with some catch and shoots and then had too many turnovers. They started off with their run and then we were able to take an 8-point lead and then Isaiah Stewart came in and we struggled to get him stopped. And then their bigs, I think their bigs made six of their threes in the first half, but we were able to get it to manageable. And then the second half the wheels kind of fell off. We were 6 for 32 on catch and shoots of the 49s and I told the team after that, I will take those. Those are good looks. 6 for 32, that's below 20%. We're not going to shoot like that.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori on the team shooting 6 for 32 on catch and shoot attempts tonight: I told the team after that, I will take those. Those are good looks. 6 for 32, that is below 20 percent. We are not going to shoot like that.

structured.context: Micah Nori discusses the team's poor shooting performance and high turnover count during the postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on the team's rebounding and defensive lapses
quotes.excerpt: we got some lapses on the rebounding and not boxing out. Donovan is down there.
quotes.quote: The disconcerting part was the fact that we let the fact that we weren't making shots get into the fact that we had some lapses on the rebounding and not boxing out. Donovan is down there. They've got some bigs, that's what they do, they crash and he's down there working. We got to get some smalls more involved. And then again, just played in a crowd a little bit too much and that led to the turnovers.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says the most disconcerting part of tonight was letting missed shots affect their defensive effort: We let the fact that we were not making shots get into the fact that we had some lapses on the rebounding and not boxing out.

structured.context: Micah Nori addresses the team's defensive lapses and rebounding struggles following the loss.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on Josh Giddey's injury status
quotes.excerpt: he fell to twinge and then I was trying to take a foul to get him out
quotes.quote: I think there's going to be he'll get evaluated right now. He was a little bit of a he fell to twinge and then I was trying to take a foul to get him out and we were forcing turnovers and so we had to make a few more runs than what I wanted him to, but I think it was just more of a twinge. They're going to evaluate him now and then probably have more answers for you tomorrow after they look at it.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says Josh Giddey will be evaluated for a twinge he felt during the game. Nori says they will likely have more answers on his status tomorrow.

structured.context: Micah Nori provides an update on Josh Giddey who is being evaluated for a potential injury.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on the decision to play Potter in the second half
quotes.excerpt: it was just trying to mix something up a little bit maybe change something up
quotes.quote: It was just trying to mix something up a little bit maybe change something up and just tried to give us every opportunity and looks to see what we can do. Brandon, his first action it was fine. Potter shoots the three ball pretty good. We weren't making any shots and then it just so happened that Isaiah Stewart, he did a heck of a job on the glass. But that's all that was. It was just a matter of trying to find a rhythm for our guys and always trying to find a five that can sustain and maybe extend the lead or cut into one.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori on the decision to play Potter in the second half: It was just trying to mix something up a little bit maybe change something up and just tried to give us every opportunity and looks to see what we can do.

structured.context: Micah Nori explains the reasoning behind his rotation changes and playing Potter in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on the team's missed free throws
quotes.excerpt: it sucks when you are down and you are trying to get it to a two possession
quotes.quote: I really don't know. The guys that are missing, the ones that are, you know, Dane and Denny. I mean, Denny goes 8 for 12, Dane goes 2 for 4, so that's obviously 10 for 16 there. So everybody else were what, 7 for 10 or whatever? And those guys are probably like the, you know, city misses two. I would say I'm a little concerned but not going to go crazy over it because I do think that we're going to make free throws. It just sucks when you are down and you are trying to get it to a two possession or three possession game and you miss a couple free throws and then they go down and score.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori on the team's free throw struggles: I would say I am a little concerned but not going to go crazy over it because I do think that we are going to make free throws.

structured.context: Micah Nori reacts to the team's missed free throws during the game.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on the importance of film study for team discipline
quotes.excerpt: you don't accept in victory what you wouldn't accept in defeat
quotes.quote: I think it's great. I think that the one thing as you go through this and you pick up things over the course of whatever, quarter of a season in this league is you don't accept in victory what you wouldn't accept in defeat. My point is even in when we win, we want to show those things and we've been very fortunate because there's been a lot of good tape. But to your point, Bill, it's it's good to have some tape on so that it shows that when you do the things that Jay and Mike and those guys offensively we're trying to preach and they see it and then they see what happens when you try to do too much and playing in those crowds, that it is good to have that on tape.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori on the importance of film study: You do not accept in victory what you would not accept in defeat. It is good to have some tape on so that it shows what happens when you try to do too much.

structured.context: Micah Nori discusses the importance of using game film to maintain team discipline regardless of the outcome.
